title: MZ RPG Maker MZ crashes when moving the editor between monitors (multi-monitor issue?)

posts.author: rafaeljbi
posts.body:
Hello,
I’ve been using a dual-monitor setup for many years because it makes it much easier to inspect details on a larger screen. However, for years I’ve been forced to keep RPG Maker MZ only on my main monitor, because the editor consistently crashes when I move it to the secondary display.
Whenever I accidentally drag the editor window from my primary monitor to the secondary one, MZ freezes or crashes completely, and I lose any unsaved progress. The same happens if I right-click and the options menu spans across both screens.
This is not a recent issue, it has been happening consistently for years and across multiple installations and projects.
It also never opens properly on the second screen. In one case, I even had to fully reinstall the engine to make it usable again, which took weeks to recover my workflow...
My two monitors have different color profiles, so I like to preview the game on both displays to ensure visual consistency, but this bug makes that impossible.
I found reports from other users mentioning similar behavior when moving MZ between monitors, so I’m wondering if this is a known limitation of the editor or an unresolved bug.
Is there any known fix, workaround, or official plan to address multi-monitor stability in RPG Maker MZ?
[Edit] I'm using Windows 11, but it happens in every version of the Windows.
Thank you.
